item.title: Borden Cheese unpacks three craveworthy cheese dips
item.description: Whether you're hosting a high-stakes hoops watch party or adding bang to your broccoli at dinner, new Borden Cheese Dips, made with real milk, is now available. The Chicago-based company invites consumers to “dip deliciously with Borden’s new Triple Threat.”

item.title: Chipwich debuts two new flavors
item.description: Vanilla Chocolate Almond and Brown Butter Pecan feature premium nut pieces rolled around the outside of the sandwich.

item.title: Milk demineralization a critical step for processors
item.description: Explore how membrane technologies are changing milk demineralization to meet the rising demand for high-value dairy ingredients while balancing efficiency and product quality.

item.title: DuPont expands FilmTec reverse osmosis element dairy portfolio
item.description: FilmTec MXP RO-8038-FF reverse osmosis element provides enhanced productivity and operational performance in a mesh-wrapped configuration, enabling high-quality dairy products.

item.title: New museum exhibit is all about milk
item.description: Explore & More: The Ralph C. Wilson Children’s Museum in upstate New York unveiled its “Moo-ve The Milk” exhibit presented by UNC Dairy and Milk For Health, providing families a fun and interactive look into the world of dairy farming.

item.title: Horizon Organic offers No Added Sugar 1% Lowfat chocolate milk boxes
item.description: The new milk boxes are also lactose free, deliver 8g of protein per serving and are shelf stable, making them perfect to enjoy at home or on-the-go, no refrigeration needed.

item.title: CVT Soft Serve inks Sprouts partnership
item.description: To celebrate the partnership, CVT has created the first new flavors in the company’s history — Strawberry and Coffee — after serving its signature namesake Chocolate, Vanilla and Twist flavors for over a decade.

item.title: Flexible packaging to continue its upward pace
item.description: The dairy processing industry is evolving, leading to advances in packaging. According to Future Market Insights Inc., the global dairy packaging market is projected to grow from $25.9 billion in 2025 to $39.2 billion by 2035, with a compound annual growth rate of 4.2%.

item.title: Forager Project introduces four new products
item.description: The expansion comes less than a year after the brand launched its 24 oz Unsweetened Plain Greek Style Yogurt.

item.title: Magnum Ice Cream named Coachella Festival sponsor
item.description: Magnum will host an exclusive experience for Coachella VIP pass holders—a signature spray bar activation that allows guests to customize a Magnum Ice Cream Bar with edible spray paint inspired by their festival outfit, offering cool, fashion-forward indulgence in the desert heat.
